strings.zh: 您好,需要我送您回一之岛吗？{NEWLINE}每人次服务费500元。
strings.en: Hello. Would you like me to take you{NEWLINE}back to One Island? The fare is $500{CLEAR}per person.

strings.zh: 随时恭候您的光临。
strings.en: We’re always at your service.

strings.zh: 好的,请跟我来吧。
strings.en: Very well. Please follow me.

strings.zh: 抱歉,您身上的钱不够支付服务费。
strings.en: Sorry, you don’t have enough money to{NEWLINE}pay the fare.

strings.zh: 啊,真是的！{NEWLINE}你太强了啦！
strings.en: Aw, come on! You’re way too strong!

strings.zh: 直到变强为止,{NEWLINE}我要一个人在这里特训！
strings.en: I’m going to train here by myself until I{NEWLINE}get stronger!

strings.zh: 只要有喜欢的精灵,{NEWLINE}不管是什么地方我都会去,{CLEAR}这就是真正的训练师！
strings.en: If there’s a Pokémon I like, I’ll go{NEWLINE}anywhere for it. That’s what a real{CLEAR}Trainer is!

strings.zh: 比起对战来,{NEWLINE}我更喜欢培育精灵。
strings.en: I like raising Pokémon more than{NEWLINE}battling them.

strings.zh: 每周只有一次,{NEWLINE}那只精灵会到水边来。{SCROLL}真想见到那精灵……{NEWLINE}真的好想。
strings.en: Only once a week does that Pokémon{NEWLINE}come down to the water.{SCROLL}I’d love to see it... I really would.

strings.zh: 这里是五之岛。{NEWLINE}一岛有四季的梦幻之岛。
strings.en: This is Five Island. The dreamlike island{NEWLINE}with all four seasons in one.

strings.zh: 这座五之岛似乎蕴藏着{NEWLINE}一股神奇的力量,{CLEAR}拥有着包罗万象的季节,{CLEAR}拥有着包罗万象的可能性。
strings.en: This Five Island seems to hold some{NEWLINE}mysterious power. It has every season,{CLEAR}and every possibility.

strings.zh: 我们准备逛完水都群岛之后,{NEWLINE}就去城都地区的度假区玩。{CLEAR}听说那里正在举办情侣双打比赛,{CLEAR}我和女朋友也想参赛试试。{SCROLL}如果你不介意的话,{NEWLINE}能先在这里跟我们来场{CLEAR}双打比赛练练手吗？
strings.en: After we’ve seen the Alto Mare Islands,{NEWLINE}we’re going to the Resort Zone in{CLEAR}Johto. I hear they’re holding a Couples{CLEAR}Double Battle there, and my girlfriend{CLEAR}and I want to give it a shot.{SCROLL}If you don’t mind, could we have a{NEWLINE}Double Battle with you here first{CLEAR}for practice?
strings.notes: #11-#14: tourist couple heading to the Resort Zone's Couples Double Battle.

strings.zh: 我们可是有很认真地{NEWLINE}在准备双打比赛哦,{CLEAR}你可不要轻敌了。
strings.en: We’ve been preparing very seriously for{NEWLINE}the Double Battle, you know. Don’t{CLEAR}underestimate us.

strings.zh: 没想到你这么厉害,{NEWLINE}看来要想赢下情侣双打比赛,{CLEAR}还需要多准备准备啊。
strings.en: I didn’t expect you to be this good.{NEWLINE}Looks like we’ll need more practice if we{CLEAR}want to win the Couples Double Battle.

strings.zh: 你好呀,我正和男朋友{NEWLINE}在水都群岛旅游呢。{CLEAR}等这里逛遍了之后,{CLEAR}我们就去城都地区的度假区玩。
strings.en: Hi there! My boyfriend and I are touring{NEWLINE}the Alto Mare Islands. Once we’ve seen{CLEAR}everything here, we’re off to the{CLEAR}Resort Zone in Johto.

strings.zh: 听说五之岛的北面{NEWLINE}还有一座幻之小岛,{CLEAR}但是岛上的和尚们{CLEAR}却不让一般游客。{CLEAR}真想过去一看究竟啊！
strings.en: I hear there’s a mysterious little{NEWLINE}island north of Five Island. But the{CLEAR}monks on the island won’t let regular{CLEAR}tourists go there. I really want to go{CLEAR}see it for myself!

strings.zh: 我儿子带着不良蛙来旅游,{NEWLINE}但是不良蛙现在好像因为缺水{CLEAR}显得很没有精神。{CLEAR}你能帮忙找一瓶水来给不良蛙吗？
strings.en: My son brought his Croagunk on our{NEWLINE}trip, but Croagunk seems really listless{CLEAR}from lack of water. Could you help find{CLEAR}a bottle of water for Croagunk?

strings.zh: 要把身上的月见山泉水送给她吗？
strings.en: Give her the Fresh Water?

strings.zh: 呀,谢谢你送给我泉水,{NEWLINE}这样一来不良蛙的干燥皮肤{CLEAR}就能得到滋润了。
strings.en: Oh, thank you for the spring water! Now{NEWLINE}Croagunk’s dry skin can get the{CLEAR}moisture it needs.

strings.zh: 来,不良蛙,清水来了哦。{NEWLINE}快用它滋润一下你的皮肤吧。
strings.en: Here, Croagunk, here’s some fresh{NEWLINE}water. Hurry and moisten your skin{CLEAR}with it.

strings.zh: 不良蛙『Croaaa——gun！{SCROLL}不良蛙恢复了精神。
strings.en: Croagunk: Croaaa-gun!{SCROLL}Croagunk perked up.

strings.zh: 太好啦！不良蛙没事啦！
strings.en: Yay! Croagunk’s okay!

strings.zh: 谢谢你送的泉水啊,{NEWLINE}真是帮了大忙了。{CLEAR}这个送给你就当作是感谢吧。
strings.en: Thank you for the spring water. You’ve{NEWLINE}been a big help. Please take this{CLEAR}as thanks.

strings.zh: 虽说是孩子嚷嚷着要养口袋妖怪的,{NEWLINE}但是毕竟他年龄还太小,{CLEAR}只能是跟精灵玩玩,{CLEAR}大多数培养的事都是我在做,{CLEAR}弄来弄去我都快成半个训练家了。
strings.en: My child begged to have a Pokémon, but{NEWLINE}he’s still too young. All he can do is{CLEAR}play with it. I end up doing most of the{CLEAR}raising, so I’ve practically become half{CLEAR}a Trainer myself.

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……我的不良蛙{NEWLINE}怎么垂头丧气的啊。
strings.en: Waaah... Why is my Croagunk so down in{NEWLINE}the dumps?

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,不良蛙又有精神了,{NEWLINE}又可以跟它一起玩喽！
strings.en: Hee hee, Croagunk’s full of energy{NEWLINE}again! Now I can play with it again!

strings.zh: 不良蛙『Croaaa……{SCROLL}不良蛙没有精神。
strings.en: Croagunk: Croaaa...{SCROLL}Croagunk has no energy.

strings.zh: 不良蛙『Croaaa——gun！
strings.en: Croagunk: Croaaa-gun!

strings.zh: 九尾『Niii——tal！
strings.en: Ninetales: Niii-tales!
strings.notes: qa-lints: unified with identical zh elsewhere (zh_variant)

strings.zh: 浅葱市有一位非常厉害的钓客,{NEWLINE}他不仅是非常厉害的钓鱼高手,{CLEAR}还是高级钓竿的收藏家。{CLEAR}我上次去他家参观的时候,{CLEAR}看到了不少非常稀有的高级钓竿呢。
strings.en: There’s an amazing angler in Olivine{NEWLINE}City. He’s not just a master fisher, he{CLEAR}collects Super Rods, too. When I visited{CLEAR}his house last time, I saw lots of really{CLEAR}rare Super Rods.

strings.zh: 我正在寻找四叶草{NEWLINE}给我的精灵治病,{CLEAR}就算这岛上的草再多,{CLEAR}只要我坚持不懈地去找,{CLEAR}肯定能找到四叶草。
strings.en: I’m looking for a four-leaf clover to{NEWLINE}cure my Pokémon’s illness. No matter{CLEAR}how much grass there is on this island,{CLEAR}if I keep searching, I’m sure I’ll{CLEAR}find one.
strings.notes: #30-#70: four-leaf clover scene; #52 insist (Champion forces the sale) / #53 let it go.

strings.zh: 嘿咻,根据我的观测,{NEWLINE}四叶草应该就在这棵树附近。
strings.en: Heave-ho... According to my{NEWLINE}observations, the four-leaf clover{CLEAR}should be somewhere near this tree.

strings.zh: 我正在采集重要的植物,{NEWLINE}不要来打扰我！
strings.en: I’m gathering an important plant. Don’t{NEWLINE}bother me!

strings.zh: 啊！那可草！{NEWLINE}那棵草不正是四叶草吗！
strings.en: Ah! That plant! Isn’t that plant a{NEWLINE}four-leaf clover?!
strings.notes: | RV004: meaning: 那可草 (typo for 那棵草) is 'that plant', not 'that's it'

strings.zh: 太好了！终于让我找到了！{NEWLINE}传说中能吸引到梦幻的幸运四叶草！{CLEAR}哈哈,要是把这个给卖掉,{CLEAR}一定能赚不少钱……
strings.en: Yes! I finally found it! The legendary{NEWLINE}lucky four-leaf clover that attracts{CLEAR}Mew! Ha ha, if I sell this, I’m sure to{CLEAR}make a pile of money...

strings.zh: 有人在说四叶草吗？{NEWLINE}是有人找到了四叶草吗？！
strings.en: Did someone say four-leaf clover? Did{NEWLINE}somebody find a four-leaf clover?!

strings.zh: 请问是你刚才说找到四叶草了吗？
strings.en: Excuse me, was it you who just said you{NEWLINE}found a four-leaf clover?

strings.zh: 对啊,是我找到四叶草了,{NEWLINE}有什么问题吗？
strings.en: Yeah, I’m the one who found it. Got a{NEWLINE}problem with that?

strings.zh: 是这样的,我的精灵生了重病,{NEWLINE}需要用四叶草为它治疗,{CLEAR}请问你能把四叶草让给我吗？
strings.en: It’s like this. My Pokémon is seriously{NEWLINE}ill, and I need a four-leaf clover to{CLEAR}cure it. Would you please let me{CLEAR}have it?

strings.zh: 你说什么？把四叶草让给你？{NEWLINE}我真是从没见过你这么厚颜无耻的。{CLEAR}这四叶草多么难找你知道吗？{CLEAR}我为了找到它{CLEAR}付出了多少心血你知道吗？{CLEAR}我还指望把它卖了致富呢,{CLEAR}你居然想直接从我这拿走四叶草？
strings.en: What? Let you have it? I’ve never seen{NEWLINE}anyone as shameless as you. Do you{CLEAR}know how hard these are to find?{SCROLL}Do you know how much blood, sweat and{NEWLINE}tears I put into finding it? I’m counting{CLEAR}on selling it to get rich, and you want{CLEAR}to just take it off my hands?
strings.notes: tone review: 厚颜无耻 is a harsh 'shameless' insult; kept at full strength (D-0627)

strings.zh: 不是的不是的,如果你是想卖钱,{NEWLINE}就请把它卖给我吧,{CLEAR}我还指望它来给我的精灵治病呢。
strings.en: No, no! If you want to sell it, then{NEWLINE}please sell it to me. I’m counting on it{CLEAR}to cure my Pokémon.

strings.zh: 这还像句人话。{NEWLINE}这四叶草按照市场价一棵200万,{CLEAR}拿钱来吧。
strings.en: Now that sounds more like human talk.{NEWLINE}At market price, one four-leaf clover{CLEAR}goes for $2,000,000. Pay up.
strings.notes: | RV004: softened: 这还像句人话 keeps its sneer ('finally sounds human')

strings.zh: 200万！！？？{SCROLL}可我身上只有30万,{NEWLINE}你看能不能便宜点……
strings.en: $2,000,000?!?!{SCROLL}But I only have $300,000 on me. Could{NEWLINE}you maybe lower the price a little...

strings.zh: 30万？你怎么不去抢呢？{NEWLINE}这四叶草可是{CLEAR}能吸引到梦幻的珍稀植物,{CLEAR}传说当年火箭队就是靠这个{CLEAR}才抓到梦幻的。{CLEAR}就算卖是200万也有大把人买,{CLEAR}你想让我30万卖给你？{CLEAR}滚远点吧,商业可不是慈善！
strings.en: $300,000? Why don’t you just rob me?{NEWLINE}This four-leaf clover is a rare plant{CLEAR}that can attract Mew. Legend has it{CLEAR}that’s how Team Rocket caught Mew back{CLEAR}in the day.{SCROLL}Plenty of people would buy it even at{NEWLINE}$2,000,000, and you want it for{CLEAR}$300,000? Get lost! Business{CLEAR}isn’t charity!
But...

strings.zh: 要帮忙求情吗？
strings.en: Speak up for him?

strings.zh: 那我再去别处找找,{NEWLINE}四叶草总不会只有这一棵的。
strings.en: Then I’ll go look somewhere else. This{NEWLINE}can’t be the only four-leaf{CLEAR}clover around.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『请不要这么决绝,{NEWLINE}这棵四叶草关系着一只精灵的生命,{CLEAR}何况30万的数额已经不少了。{CLEAR}虽说怎么处置四叶草是你的自由,{CLEAR}但请你再考虑一下吧,{CLEAR}做事也不应该一切向钱看不是吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Please don’t be so harsh. This{NEWLINE}four-leaf clover could save a Pokémon’s{CLEAR}life, and $300,000 is no small amount.{SCROLL}What you do with the clover is up to{NEWLINE}you, but please think it over. Money{CLEAR}shouldn’t be everything, should it?

strings.zh: 你个过路的多管什么闲事,{NEWLINE}你要想帮他拿到这棵四叶草,{CLEAR}那就替他补齐剩下的170万,{CLEAR}否则免谈！
strings.en: What’s a passerby like you butting in{NEWLINE}for? If you want to help him get this{CLEAR}clover, then cover the other{CLEAR}$1,700,000 for him. Otherwise,{CLEAR}forget it!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我也没有那么多钱……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I don’t have that much{NEWLINE}money either...

strings.zh: 那就有多远滚多远吧。
strings.en: Then get lost. The farther, the better.
strings.notes: tone review: 有多远滚多远 uses the rude 滚; kept rude as 'get lost', matching 滚远点 in #43 (D-0627)

strings.zh: 要怎么办呢？
strings.en: What will you do?

strings.zh: 今天你必须卖四叶草
strings.en: You’re selling it today

strings.zh: 算了,不管了
strings.en: Forget it

strings.zh: 可以了,谢谢你出言相助,{NEWLINE}既然人家不肯卖,{CLEAR}那我再去别处找找就是了,{CLEAR}四叶草总不会只有这一棵的。
strings.en: It’s all right. Thank you for speaking{NEWLINE}up for me. If they won’t sell, I’ll just{CLEAR}look somewhere else. This can’t be the{CLEAR}only four-leaf clover around.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『对不住了,{NEWLINE}今天为了救这位训练家的精灵,{CLEAR}你必须要以30万的价格{CLEAR}把四叶草卖给他！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sorry, but today, to save this{NEWLINE}Trainer’s Pokémon, you’re going to sell{CLEAR}him that four-leaf clover for $300,000!

strings.zh: 你他妈谁啊你！{NEWLINE}凭什么规定我卖东西的价格！
strings.en: Who the fuck are you?! What gives you{NEWLINE}the right to set my prices?!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}今天你愿意也好不愿意也好,{CLEAR}我以紧急事态下的特权命令你,{CLEAR}必须以30万的价格{CLEAR}把四叶草卖给这位训练家！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m the League Champion,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}! Whether you like it or not, I’m{CLEAR}using my emergency powers to order you{CLEAR}to sell this four-leaf clover to this{CLEAR}Trainer for $300,000!

strings.zh: 仔细一看,真的是冠军大人哎！
strings.en: Now that I look closely, it really is{NEWLINE}the Champion!

strings.zh: 胡……胡说！你根本不是联盟冠军！{NEWLINE}你们就是合起伙来抢我东西的强盗,{CLEAR}我跟你们拼了！
strings.en: L-liar! You’re no League Champion! You{NEWLINE}two are just robbers ganging up to{CLEAR}steal my stuff! I’ll fight you to{CLEAR}the death!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『现在能老实点了吧？{NEWLINE}赶紧完成四叶草的交易吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ready to behave now? Hurry up{NEWLINE}and finish selling the four-leaf clover!

strings.zh: 啊……不,啊不是……{NEWLINE}好,我卖就是了……
strings.en: Ah... N-no, I mean... Fine, I’ll{NEWLINE}sell it...

strings.zh: 呐,30万买四叶草,{NEWLINE}一分都不能少,拿钱来吧！
strings.en: There. $300,000 for the four-leaf{NEWLINE}clover. Not a cent less. Pay up!

strings.zh: 没问题,这是30万,请拿好。
strings.en: No problem. Here’s $300,000. Please{NEWLINE}take it.

strings.zh: 切,这是四叶草,给你！
strings.en: Tch. Here’s your four-leaf clover!

strings.zh: 谢谢冠军大人出手相助！{NEWLINE}我这就拿四叶草回去给精灵做药,{CLEAR}谢谢冠军大人！
strings.en: Thank you for your help, Champion! I’ll{NEWLINE}take the four-leaf clover back and make{CLEAR}medicine for my Pokémon right away.{CLEAR}Thank you, Champion!

strings.zh: 一夜暴富的梦都让你给毁了,{NEWLINE}什么联盟冠军,都是狗屁！
strings.en: You wrecked my dream of getting rich{NEWLINE}overnight! League Champion? Bullshit!

strings.zh: 哈哈,一棵四叶草在手,{NEWLINE}百万现金我有！
strings.en: Ha ha! With a four-leaf clover in hand,{NEWLINE}a million bucks is mine!

strings.zh: 根据我自学的植物学知识推测,{NEWLINE}四叶草应该就生长在这附近！
strings.en: Based on the botany I taught myself, a{NEWLINE}four-leaf clover should be growing{CLEAR}somewhere around here!

strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛,前面是佛门禁地,{NEWLINE}施主请止步……
strings.en: Amitabha. Beyond this point is holy{NEWLINE}ground. Please stop here, traveler...

strings.zh: 呀,您是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}大人！{NEWLINE}请问您是要到前面去吗？
strings.en: Oh! You are League Champion {VAR:0103:0}!{NEWLINE}Do you wish to go on ahead?

strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛,五之岛随时欢迎{NEWLINE}您的大驾光临。
strings.en: Amitabha. Five Island welcomes your{NEWLINE}visit at any time.

strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛,既然是冠军大人造访,{NEWLINE}那就另当别论了,{CLEAR}冠军大人请自便。
strings.en: Amitabha. Since it is the Champion who{NEWLINE}visits, that is another matter. Please{CLEAR}go as you wish, Champion.

strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛,欢迎冠军大人大驾光临。
strings.en: Amitabha. Welcome, Champion. You honor{NEWLINE}us with your visit.

strings.zh: 吸盘魔偶『Miii——me！{SCROLL}吸盘魔偶在扫地。
strings.en: Mr. Mime: Miii-me!{SCROLL}Mr. Mime is sweeping the floor.

strings.zh: 我的卡比兽是个贪吃鬼,{NEWLINE}不吃饱的话绝对不会回到精灵球中。{SCROLL}但是它最爱吃的神奇糖果、{NEWLINE}森之羊羹、飞音饼这些零食,{CLEAR}在水都群岛很难弄到。{CLEAR}唉,这可如何是好啊。
strings.en: My Snorlax is a glutton. It will never go{NEWLINE}back into its Poké Ball until it’s full.{SCROLL}But its favorite snacks, Rare Candy,{NEWLINE}Old Gateau and Lava Cookies, are hard{CLEAR}to come by in the Alto Mare Islands. Oh,{CLEAR}what am I to do?

strings.zh: 这些零食我都有
strings.en: I have those snacks

strings.zh: 与我无关
strings.en: Not my business

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我这里正好有这些零食,{NEWLINE}你看够卡比兽吃的吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I happen to have those{NEWLINE}snacks. Do you think it’s enough{CLEAR}for Snorlax?

strings.zh: 呀,施主你带着零食！？{NEWLINE}这可真是太好了。{CLEAR}让我看一下啊……
strings.en: Oh, you have snacks, traveler?! That is{NEWLINE}wonderful. Let me take a look...

strings.zh: 哎呀,多谢施主的好意,{NEWLINE}但是施主身上带着的零食{CLEAR}根本不够卡比兽吃的。{CLEAR}我还是再想想别的办法吧……
strings.en: Oh dear. Thank you for your kindness,{NEWLINE}traveler, but the snacks you have are{CLEAR}nowhere near enough for Snorlax. I{CLEAR}shall have to think of something else...

strings.zh: 阿弥陀佛,施主竟然带着这么多零食,{NEWLINE}这下肯定能够喂饱卡比兽。{CLEAR}我这就叫这个吃货起来。
strings.en: Amitabha. You carry so many snacks,{NEWLINE}traveler! This will surely fill Snorlax{CLEAR}up. I will wake the glutton at once.

strings.zh: 卡比兽,开饭了！是你最爱吃的零食哦！
strings.en: Snorlax, dinnertime! It’s your{NEWLINE}favorite snacks!

strings.zh: 卡比兽『Snooo——la！
strings.en: Snorlax: Snooo-la!

strings.zh: 好啦,吃饱了就回来吧,卡比兽。
strings.en: There. Now that you’re full, come{NEWLINE}back, Snorlax.

strings.zh: 多谢施主赠饭之恩,{NEWLINE}这个是小僧平时修行用的道具,{CLEAR}请施主收下,就当是小僧的谢礼了。
strings.en: Thank you for the meal, traveler. This{NEWLINE}is an item this humble monk uses in his{CLEAR}daily training. Please accept it as{CLEAR}my thanks.
